biography.value:
Description

Standing as tall as a human, this muscular, green-skinned creature with bird claws as feet peers her opponent down looking to steal another item for her collection.

Defense

AC 17, touch 14, flat-footed 13 (+3 armor, +3 dex, +1 dodge)

hp 25 [33] (3d8+9)

Fort +3, Ref +6 Will +2

Defensive Abilities Danger Sense (+1)

Offense

Speed 40 ft.

Melee Sickle +5 (1d6+3)

Special Attacks Magic Hammer, Sneak Attack (+2d6)

Special Abilities Mark, Measure the Mark

Statistics

Str 14, Dex 16, Con 14, Int 14, Wis 12, Cha 8

Base Atk +2; CMB +4; CMD 17

Feats Combat Expertise, Dodge, Improved Steal, Weapon Finesse

Skills Acrobatics +7, Climb +6, Disable Device +7 (+8 vs traps), Disguise +3, Escape Artist +7, Perception +5 (+6 vs surprise attacks, +6 vs trap finding), Sense Motive +5, Sleight of Hand +11, Stealth +7, Use Magic Device +3; Racial Modifiers +4 competence bonus on Steal combat maneuvers and Sleight of Hand

Languages Common, Goblin, Undercommon

SQ Trapfinding, Finesse Training (Sickle), Escape, Evasion, Thief Talent (Combat Swipe)

Combat Gear cure potion (1), sickle, studded leather

description.value: Defensive ability listed in the source statblock: Danger Sense.
Vice are slightly faster at escaping from their foes and have their speed increased by 10 ft. They tend to escape after they successfully steal an item or lower than 10 hp.

effect: The 10-foot increase is included in the 40-foot land speed. Vice typically flees after stealing or when below 10 HP.

description.value: 3/day, a vice can summon a magical hammer and launches (+5 ranged touch attack) it at a single target within 30 feet for 1d4 points of MP damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 17).

effect: Ranged touch for MP damage, not HP. No additional save.

description.value: Mark

effect: Observe a creature for a full round. Perception DC 10 + target level/HD or its higher disguise result. On success designate it as the mark; maintain as a free action each round.

effect: Before attempting Sleight of Hand to take an item, learn the target's Perception result. Proceed or decline; on declining, opposed Bluff vs. Sense Motive can conceal the attempt.
